svg.title: APMS Complete Event Flow
svg.desc: Sequential flow of all events in the Academic Project Monitoring System, from setup to archival

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about coordinator creating departments and faculty in APMS')
g.text: 1. Coordinator registers faculty & marks active
Registers faculty members and ensures active statuses

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about batch creation in APMS')
g.text: 2. Coordinator initializes Batch & sets modes/limits
Enforces constraints like Project Mode and Max Group Size

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are students enrolled into batches in APMS?')
g.text: 3. Coordinator assigns active faculty to Batch
Links specific faculty members available for guide allocation

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does deadline and rubric configuration work in APMS?')
g.text: 4. Coordinator defines Topic Submission Window
Sets strict Start and End dates for student project setup

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do students form project groups in APMS?')
g.text: 5. Student initiates project setup in submission window
Form adapts to coordinator enforced project modes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is a guide allocated to a student group in APMS?')
g.text: 6. Student inputs topic title, domain, and abstract
Defines the primary research scope of the project

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does topic submission work in APMS?')
g.text: 7. Student adds team members via email search
Dynamically adds members up to the max group size

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a guide review and approve a project topic in APMS?')
g.text: 8. Auto-leadership & pending invitations sent
Initiator becomes Group Leader; peers receive invites

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does coordinator final topic approval do in APMS?')
g.text: 9. Guides are allocated to project groups
AI Engine supports balancing the faculty workload

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does milestone setup work in APMS?')
g.text: 10. Guide reviews proposed project topic
Topic and abstract verified against department standards

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Kanban task board work for students in APMS?')
g.text: 11. Coordinator/Guide finalizes topic approval
Project lifecycle begins officially once topic is approved

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does document upload and versioning work in APMS?')
g.text: 12. Students manage tasks on Kanban board
Breaks down work into To Do / In Progress / Done

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does guide document review and inline feedback work in APMS?')
g.text: 13. Git repositories are linked for analytics
System tracks commit histories and code sync activity

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do meetings and chat work in APMS?')
g.text: 14. Documents are uploaded to Submission Portal

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does plagiarism detection work in APMS?')
g.text: 15. In-app Chat enables continuous communication

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does rubric-based evaluation work in APMS?')
g.text: 16. Guides monitor Kanban & Git activity
Oversees the real-time execution of the project

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the AI risk detection work in APMS?')
g.text: 17. AI Risk Engine monitors progress continuously
Analyzes task completion rates and repository syncs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does mid-term review work in APMS?')
g.text: 18. AI flags at-risk students in Compliance Tracker
Automated alerts sent to Guide based on risk scores

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does final project submission work in APMS?')
g.text: 19. Guide reviews document submissions
Provides feedback and marks documents for revision

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does final evaluation work in APMS?')
g.text: 20. Project revisions are requested or approved
Ensures deliverables meet all required standards

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens at final coordinator approval in APMS?')
g.text: 21. Coordinator deactivates or archives Batch
Manually closes the batch at the end of academic cycle

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does project archival and reporting work in APMS?')
g.text: 22. Project cycle concludes (Future: AI Final Approval)
Data drives department analytics dashboard updates
